keywords: 机密同质化代币 ERC 合并
极简头像智能钱包 ERC 合并
BAL 让以太坊告别单车道执行
summary: arr00 的机密同质化代币 ERC 合并，余额与转账金额加密。MostafaS 的极简头像智能钱包（MASW）ERC 合并。nero_eth 解释 EIP-7928 BAL 让区块携带精确的访问映射，使并行执行成为可能。ethStaker 展示 ZK 质押节点收到 3/3 执行证明。

keywords_en: A Confidential Fungible Token ERC merged
a Minimal Avatar Smart Wallet ERC merged
BAL ends Ethereum's single lane execution
summary_en: arr00's Confidential Fungible Token ERC merged, with encrypted balances and amounts. MostafaS's Minimal Avatar Smart Wallet (MASW) ERC merged. nero_eth explained that EIP-7928 BAL gives each block a precise access map, enabling parallel execution. ethStaker showed a ZK staking node receiving 3/3 execution proofs.
